scope: existing scalar pilot and corrective profile-bank v2

relevant_facts: The household release documents that meters provide cumulative energy in kWh.
The 15-minute file is a regular interpolated time series and its interpolation marker identifies columns by name.
The selected grid_import and pv fields are documented as energy in kWh, not instantaneous kW.

fatal_or_major_blockers.evidence: scripts/process_opsd.py:6,11-12 treats cumulative kWh as kW, sums it and multiplies by 0.25, and reports the cumulative series peak as kW.
fatal_or_major_blockers.repair: Use scripts/build_profile_bank_v2.py:build_opsd, which first-differences each selected cumulative channel and divides by actual elapsed hours. Rebuild OPSD results or label the old OPSD output as invalid.

fatal_or_major_blockers.evidence: scripts/process_opsd.py:12 uses g.interpolated.notna().mean(), which is one for every non-null marker cell and does not test whether either selected column is named in the marker.
fatal_or_major_blockers.repair: Use selected-column token matching in build_profile_bank_v2.py; publish fractions separately for load and PV.

fatal_or_major_blockers.evidence: scripts/build_opsd_scenarios.py:8-9 and scripts/build_ausgrid_scenarios.py:12-18 rank daily totals and replace each waveform with load_scale and pv_fraction. OpenDSS then applies these constants through opendss_adapter.py:solve rather than the measured trajectories.
fatal_or_major_blockers.repair: Use the interval-resolved NPZ banks. If the main experiment is still scalar, remove claims that measured profiles validate it and call the data a synthetic scaling check.

fatal_or_major_blockers.evidence: scripts/run_pilot.py:45-68 searches for the largest accepted offer by calling audit_sequence with the hidden forecast error on every candidate; run_opsd_pilot.py and run_ausgrid_pilot.py report those same audits as pilot/held-out outcomes.
fatal_or_major_blockers.repair: Fit/select offer on train only, freeze it, calibrate one margin on calibration dates, and evaluate once on disjoint test dates. Keep test trajectories inaccessible to offer selection.

fatal_or_major_blockers.evidence: src/recoveryflex/envelope.py:22-30 defines robust_margin and derate=1-3*margin; the reported telemetry uplift is therefore imposed by the candidate formula, not estimated from telemetry or an observation model.
fatal_or_major_blockers.repair: Remove telemetry as a causal/operational result, or add a declared observation-error experiment in which telemetry changes a held-out estimate and report the result as an ablation.

fatal_or_major_blockers.evidence: scripts/build_metrics_report.py:11-12 treats every row as an independent Bernoulli trial. Rows repeat the same scenario, site, duration, recovery, telemetry, and hidden error; event audits are also repeated within each row.
fatal_or_major_blockers.repair: Report descriptive rates by independent day/scenario cluster and bootstrap dates (or use a cluster-robust interval). Do not call row-level Wilson intervals confidence intervals for generalization.

corrective_bank_v2.ausgrid: 365 complete dates, 300 customers, 10 fixed seeded customer groups, 48 half-hour average-kW points, GC+CL load and GG PV; 214/71/80 train/cal/test by within-month chronological split
corrective_bank_v2.opsd: 660 complete dates, 96 15-minute average-kW points, cumulative-to-increment conversion, selected-column flags; 387/128/145 train/cal/test by within-month chronological split
known_limits: Ausgrid profiles are household-level and are mapped to feeder groups synthetically; the mapping is recorded but is not a measured feeder topology.
OPSD contains one selected household pair and remains an external profile check rather than independent feeder evidence.
A fresh train/calibration/test experiment must be rerun before any manuscript results are trusted.
